designStatus: proposed ground asset format; requires a dedicated app reader

winter.status: approved art for the disabled winter pack

connectionMask.setBitWhen: Adjacent cell belongs to the same saved day's 6x6 board and has mergeGroup soil. Ignore object occupancy.

geometry.origin: top corner of logical cell; draw frame with pixel offset (-16,0)
geometry.boundary: Perimeter texels reveal the monthly ground through hard transparency. Only four shared sides connect; diagonal-only tiles stay separate. Concave corners use a simple L silhouette.
geometry.projection: Image is already isometric and sits flush on the top face.

furrows.phase: Aligned to logical board coordinates. Ends enter smooth soil at a Dirt Patch boundary.

drawSequence: existing foreground object pass and interaction overlays in the app's normal order
fallback: Missing seasonal atlas uses base atlas for this item. Missing base atlas reveals monthly ground; retain the placement.
